name: clog
description: A static blog generator for djot.

scripts.code: npm run fmt && npm run lint && npm run lint:css && npm run typecheck
scripts.build: npm run code && node --env-file-if-exists=.env src/cli.ts build
scripts.serve: npm run code && node --env-file-if-exists=.env src/cli.ts serve
scripts.check: npm run code && npm test && node --env-file-if-exists=.env src/cli.ts build && npm run verify:output
